Ford introduces the Model T.
Charles Schulz's Peanuts comic strip first appears.
Germany is reunified.
Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, is launched.
Dr. No, the first James Bond film, premieres.
The Jazz Singer premieres, ushering in talking pictures.
Luna 3 takes the first photos of the Moon's far side.
The first fully implanted pacemaker is fitted.
The Washington Monument opens to the public.
The Outer Space Treaty comes into force.
Apollo 7 launches, the first crewed Apollo mission.
Columbus reaches the Americas.
Delegates vote to make Greenwich the world's prime meridian.
Chuck Yeager breaks the sound barrier.
The Cassini spacecraft launches toward Saturn.
Walt and Roy Disney found the Disney Brothers Studio.
Albert Einstein arrives in the United States.
The British Broadcasting Company is founded.
The British surrender at Yorktown.
The Sydney Opera House is opened.
Edison's carbon-filament lamp burns for over 13 hours.
Andre-Jacques Garnerin makes the first parachute jump.
Apple announces the iPod.
A V-2 rocket takes the first photo of Earth from space.
The first microwave oven for home kitchens goes on sale.
The Football Association is founded in London.
The New York City subway opens.
The Statue of Liberty is dedicated.
The first message is sent over ARPANET.
Orson Welles broadcasts The War of the Worlds.
Mount Rushmore is completed.
